WHAM, GVHMR and TRAM each recover a person's motion in world coordinates, not only relative to the camera, from one moving-camera video. WHAM uses camera angular velocity from SLAM and "a contact-aware trajectory refinement method" against foot sliding; GVHMR estimates poses in a gravity-and-view coordinate system and maps them back with camera rotations; TRAM uses a masked SLAM for camera motion and scale and a video transformer for body motion.
claims.as_first_reported: They output world-grounded SMPL motion.

checks.evidence: WHAM: "reconstructs 3D human motion in a global coordinate system from video" / "a contact-aware trajectory refinement method". GVHMR: "recovering world-grounded human motion from monocular video". TRAM: "reconstruct a human's global trajectory and motion from in-the-wild videos".
checks.notes: Read from abstracts, not measured.

claims.claim: Read from each project's install files, not installed: WHAM targets Python 3.9, PyTorch 1.11 with CUDA 11.3 and mmcv 1.3.9; GVHMR Python 3.10, PyTorch 2.3.0 with CUDA 12.1 and a matching PyTorch3D wheel; TRAM Python 3.10, PyTorch 2.4.0 with CUDA 11.8, Detectron2 and a compiled DROID-SLAM; 4D-Humans Python 3.10 with CUDA 11.8 and Detectron2; SMPLer-X Python 3.8, PyTorch 1.12 and mmcv-full 1.7.1; MotionBERT Python 3.7. SAM 3D Body's install creates a Python 3.11 environment and MHR requires Python 3.11 or newer; neither pins a PyTorch version.

claims.claim: For a game that will be sold, take motion from a hosted video mocap service on a plan whose terms you have read, as BVH, and build this repo's own retarget from BVH onto articulationxl rigs using the bone roles scripts/bone_roles.py already finds, in Blender, followed by Blender's own filters for jitter and loops.

The open route worth a trial is SAM 3D Body with MHR, fitted frame by frame and smoothed afterwards: of the open models read, it is the only one whose code, checkpoints and body model carry no non-commercial clause. Try it before building on it, because it has no temporal model and its licence can be amended by Meta.

Do not put WHAM, GVHMR, TRAM, 4D-Humans, SMPLer-X or MotionBERT into a commercial asset pipeline as released: each needs SMPL or SMPL-X, or ships non-commercial or AGPL parts, and replacing those is a project of its own.
